text: {"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate. v1’s 28 arbitrations include 20 false ones (FAR 0.714) despite recall 1.0; six of eight shown false positives have confidence below 0.7. This targets the dominant false-arbitration pattern while retaining the existing magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon protections.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
